title: An assumed smile changes model prices
hook: Two stated cases for an assumed smile changes model prices.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How two supplied strike-specific volatilities rather than a market calibration affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Call, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare two supplied strike-specific volatilities rather than a market calibration in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy European call has Spot 100, Strike 120, rate 0.03, volatility Sigma 0.2, Time 1. Under the no-dividend constant-volatility Black-Scholes model, what price results?
